summary: Iteration 6 testing complete for Tool Holders (Takım Tutucular) + Özel Takım (is_special) product flag + admin wipe-all endpoint. Added /app/backend/tests/test_toolholders.py (19 new tests): CRUD, stock in/out flows, movement filtering, RBAC 403s, ToolHolder↔Product isolation, is_special create/default/tolerance. Updated ADMIN_PW '123456' in test_rbac.py and backend_test.py to match new .env credential. FULL SUITE: 97 passed / 1 skipped (legacy user absent) in 135s. Frontend E2E via Playwright verified: admin login OK, nav-toolholders visible, Yeni Tutucu creates row with all fields, th-in modal contains NO machine dropdown (correct), th-out modal REQUIRES machine dropdown (correct), machine list populated, decrements stock; Ürünler page pf-special checkbox exists, creating with pf-special=true shows ÖZEL TAKIM badge, searching 'özel takım' filters to only is_special=true products. Wipe-all executed as final cleanup — deleted 10 products / 5 personnel / 4 machines / 1 order / 93 movements / 2 toolholders / 12 toolholder_movements; all list endpoints now return []. Admin user preserved. Viewer wipe attempt returns 403.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> is being rendered inside <option> (options in machine dropdown contain a highlighted code span). Non-blocking but should be a plain string like `${code} — ${name}` without inner spans to eliminate console warning.

action_items: Consider simplifying the machine <option> children to a plain text template to remove the React hydration warning (<span> child of <option>).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1434 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. Split into APIRouter modules (auth, products, toolholders, orders, reports, admin) for maintainability.
ToolHolder /out endpoint correctly enforces machine_id at Pydantic level (missing => 422) and at business level (invalid id => 404) — good layered validation.
Role check (require_admin) is applied on every mutation endpoint including /admin/wipe-all — verified by 403 on viewer attempt.
clean() removes _id but /toolholders GET already excludes _id via projection — consistent.
is_special has bool default False on Pydantic model, and existing docs without the field are gracefully treated as false in the frontend — tolerance confirmed.

Startup seed re-inserts SAMPLE_PRODUCTS / PERSONNEL / MACHINES whenever the collection is empty — that means the next backend restart AFTER the wipe will reseed sample data. The 'guard flag' comment in code (line 308-309) is not actually implemented. If the user restarts, sample data will reappear. Consider adding a real guard doc in a config collection or checking a marker before seeding.
